_source: Golden conversation 1 (docs/plans/text-advisor/11-testing-rollout.md § Engine golden conversations). Model responses are hand-written to the Messages API shape, not captured from the live API; the landing trip and the advisory come from tests/fixtures/feeds/ (the alert moved to the test day).
description: Golden 1 (TA-A1): a brand-new angler texts "What's biting?". The pre-router answers from the day's port answer (generated once with the forced record_daily_answer tool, since none is stored yet; no chat model call) after the welcome, then asks for the home port once. The angler names Port San Luis (the model saves it with update_profile, seeing the Morro Bay answer in its brief), asks a planning question and gets the Small Craft Advisory first with the NWS line and the port link at the end. A second plain "what's biting" for Morro Bay is the stored answer: no model call, no second home-port question.

input.en: Morro Bay, Sat Oct 3: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY posted for today. No skipper reports from the last three days. The landing reports Starfire last Sun with bocaccio, copper rockfish and 8 lingcod; recent reported activity: Low. Today's forecast isn't in yet. Full picture: {{link:port:morro-bay}}
input.es: Morro Bay, sáb 3 oct: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY (aviso del NWS) para hoy. No hay reportes de capitanes de los últimos tres días. El muelle reporta al Starfire el dom pasado con bocaccio, rocote cobrizo y 8 lingcod; actividad reciente reportada: Low. El pronóstico de hoy todavía no llega. Todo el detalle: {{link:port:morro-bay}}
